three_judgments.path: FAILS the multibagger bar; falls short of great-trade too. Mechanism: cross-border DTC secular shift ($114B TAM by 2030, BofA 'de-facto platform') compounds GMV/rev ~30% + ~22% EBITDA margin. But 4x = ~$21.6B from ~$5.4B needs rev to ~3.5-4x (to ~$4.5-5B) at a held ~4-5x sales OR multiple EXPANSION on a decelerating compounder — i.e. ~35-40% rev CAGR sustained 4yr while the co GUIDES ~30% and GMV growth visibly DECELERATES (44% Q4-24 -> 33-34% mid-25) with take-rate compression 15.5%->14.9% (multi-local/3B2C mix). Discriminators (G-relevant): margin/CF inflection SHOWN (adj-EBITDA +59% Q1-26, first GAAP profit) — strong & real; revenue acceleration only PARTIAL and FADING (high but decelerating, not accelerating). Consensus-underappreciation ABSENT: 13 analysts / 7 Strong Buy, story fully recognized, highest PT $64 (~2x), most-bullish 2030 model ~$91 (~2.8x) — NO ONE models a 4x. Honest ceiling = analyst-implied ~2-3x quality-grower re-rate, which is below BOTH the >=4x multibagger AND a high-confidence/protected 3-4x great trade (it's a merely-possible 2-3x with no single defined near-term catalyst, gradual compounding not catalyst-defined) -> neither path clears.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Bull ~2.5-3x (4yr de-facto-platform compounding) / base ~1.5-2x (analyst median ~$47-50, durable-but-decelerating 30% re-rate) / bear ~-30-40% (faster decel on tariffs/multi-local + take-rate erosion + Shopify concentration, multiple compresses to mature). U/D ~5:1 nominal — healthy for a quality name, but this is GREAT-TRADE geometry with a ceiling that doesn't reach 4x or clear a confident 3-4x; the slot bar isn't met.
three_judgments.survival: No permanent-impairment risk — easiest pass in the queue. $553M cash, no debt, GAAP-profitable, ~22% adj-EBITDA margin, strongly cash-generative; funds $430M Passport + $500M buyback from cash/ops. Ruin off the table. But strong survival doesn't make the path (S7): for a G compounder the geometry is everything, and it falls short.

strongest_bear: High-quality but now mature-trajectory compounder whose story is FULLY recognized (Strong Buy consensus; 'de-facto platform by 2030' is already the base case) — the easy multiple-expansion re-rate has happened. Growth is decelerating off a ~$1.25B rev base with structural take-rate compression (multi-local/3B2C), Shopify customer concentration, and M&A-funded TAM expansion (Passport) all signaling organic deceleration. At ~$5.4B the law of large numbers makes a 4x a venture-scale ask the financials can't support; you're paid a fair 2-3x for a de-risked leader — a good investment, not a scarce-slot multibagger.
best_vehicle: GLBE itself (Direct platform owner of the cross-border-commerce rail; standalone, no on-list benchmark cohort)
drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — real path but ceiling is a quality-grower ~2-3x re-rate (analyst-implied; 4x=~$21.6B unsupported by ~30%-and-decelerating growth at any sane multiple); falls short of BOTH the >=4x multibagger AND a high-confidence/protected 3-4x great trade (merely-possible 2-3x, no defined catalyst). No ruin, not a hard kill — just doesn't earn a scarce deep-dive slot. Theme stays live; re-enters on a cheaper entry or re-acceleration.
